limitations: Real identification proven on Edge 156 (site, error page) and Brave (HTML via association) on this station, directly and in the installed campaign; Chrome, Firefox and Chromium are absent here. No browser formally homologated.
The Open with -> Edge fallback is proven only with fakes: on the reruns the association resolved to Brave and no dialog appeared.

page_ready means the selected tab's document is committed at the target and is not a browser error page; it does not prove every resource finished loading. Firefox error schemes (about:neterror/certerror) are unproven.
